summary: chai-as-soul ships a 4 MB obfuscated payload executed at import time behind a decoy no-op middleware
details: Package name and README impersonate chai-as-promised and pino, but the actual public API exported from index.js is an unrelated no-op Express middleware. index.js unconditionally require()s./lib/config.js at load time; lib/config.js is a 4,083,936-byte single-line obfuscator.io blob (rotating string array of ~23,971 entries, hex-encoded property keys, nested decoder functions, self-defending IIFE) with no plaintext source and no relationship to the trivial middleware the package advertises. Requiring the package causes the opaque payload to execute in the caller's process. The combination of package-identity impersonation, decoy public API, and import-time execution of a multi-megabyte obfuscated module is the canonical shape of a hostile loader disguised as a chai/pino-adjacent library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
